review_comments.body: Can you reword this comment? It says the composer is registered once per factory, but the check only remembers the last factory it registered on. If `view` went A → B → A, A would get a second composer, so it's "once per change of factory" rather than "once per factory".

I think we can remove this, we have the explanation below so this adds little to the overall understanding.

We can just keep the type annotation

comments.body:
Reworded the inline comment in `wrapViewEngine()`: the guard remembers only the last view factory, so the composer is registered once per change of factory (if `view` went A -> B -> A, A gets a second composer), not once per factory and not on every engine resolve. Removed the property docblock sentence and kept the `@var` annotation.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
